items.prompt: Why can checked_add(M,1U) fail after its type constraint succeeds?

options.text: Compile-time type acceptance does not prove this value sum fits
options.why: The runtime range guard is still required.

options.text: All successful instantiations must wrap instead
options.why: The helper explicitly rejects that range failure.

options.text: Instantiating the template proves all same-type additions are representable
options.why: An accepted type has a finite range. Particular operand values still need the displayed guard.

options.text: A concept authenticates all financial amounts
options.why: It does not establish source/account/unit identity.

items.explanation: Types and values answer different contract questions; reuse does not remove runtime bounds.
